**AFDK anbefaler** is the institutional actor responsible for developing and issuing the recommended content elements for patient education concerning atrial fibrillation in Denmark [^src1]. Operating within the broader framework of the national "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" initiative—published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme—this entity establishes the foundational standards for quality indicators and clinical practice across the Danish healthcare system [^src1].

The primary significance of AFDK anbefaler lies in its direct governance over [[patientuddannelse|Patientuddannelse]] (patient education) [^src1]. The entity explicitly recommends that patient education must encompass the specific information detailed in [[tabel-1|Tabel 1]] [^src1]. Furthermore, it mandates that this educational content be adapted to the individual patient's specific situation and the format of the instruction, whether it is delivered individually or in a group setting [^src1]. By anchoring its recommendations in international guidelines (such as ESC 2024) and national clinical resources, AFDK anbefaler ensures that structured patient education and clinical follow-up meet rigorous, evidence-based quality standards [^src1].
